description: Create the fully static About Us page (src/app/about/page.tsx) with 7 sections: Hero, Our Story, Vision & Mission, 8 Core Values, Methodology, Competitive Advantages, and CTA. No Payload data fetching — all content is hardcoded. Independent of FEAT-001 (no shared files), so it can be implemented in any order, though FEAT-001 runs first by convention.
steps: Step 1: Create src/app/about/page.tsx as an async RSC (no 'use client'). Export metadata: { title: 'About Us | Pulse Consultant Ltd', description: 'Learn about Pulse Consultant Ltd — our story, vision, mission, core values, and the methodology that drives measurable results for our clients.' }.

Step 2: Section 1 — Hero (bg-navy text-white). Outer div bg-navy. Inner section-container py-24. Breadcrumb: <nav> with 'Home' link (text-white/60 hover:text-white) + ' / ' + 'About Us' (text-gold). Font-playfair text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold text-white mt-6 mb-4: 'About Pulse Consultant Ltd'. Tagline p text-white/80 text-lg md:text-xl: 'Strategic Insights. Financial Solutions. Sustainable Growth.'

Step 3: Section 2 — Our Story (bg-offwhite). section-container py-20. Grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-16 items-center. Left col: label span 'Our Story' in uppercase text-teal tracking-widest text-sm font-semibold mb-4; font-playfair text-3xl text-navy mb-6: 'Built on Expertise. Driven by Results.'; two paragraphs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed. Right col: 2x2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-6 of stat cards (bg-white rounded-lg p-6 border-t-4 border-gold shadow-card-1): font-playfair text-3xl text-gold font-bold value, text-sm text-slate-600 mt-1 label. Stats: { value: '10+', label: 'Years of Experience' }, { value: '50+', label: 'Clients Served' }, { value: '9', label: 'Advisory Services' }, { value: '5', label: 'Priority Industries' }.

Step 4: Section 3 — Vision & Mission (bg-white). section-container py-20. Centered section header: label 'Our Foundation' (teal uppercase tracking-widest text-sm), font-playfair text-3xl text-navy mb-12: 'Vision & Mission'. Grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-0 (gap managed by padding). Left col pr-8 md:border-r md:border-gold: label 'Our Vision' (text-gold uppercase tracking-wider text-xs font-semibold mb-4), font-playfair text-2xl text-navy mb-4: 'Our Vision', p text-slate-600 leading-relaxed: 'To be the most trusted financial advisory and strategic consulting firm in Africa and emerging markets, renowned for integrity, expertise, and transformational client outcomes.' Right col md:pl-8: same pattern for Mission: 'To deliver evidence-based, results-driven consulting that creates measurable, sustainable value for every client we serve — through deep industry expertise, rigorous analysis, and genuine partnership.'

Step 5: Section 4 — 8 Core Values (bg-offwhite). section-container py-20. Centered header: label 'What We Stand For', font-playfair text-3xl text-navy mb-12 'Our Core Values'. Grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Each card: bg-white rounded-lg p-6 border-t-2 border-gold shadow-card-1. Card title: font-semibold text-navy mb-2. Card desc: text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed. Cards array: [{ title: 'Integrity', desc: 'We uphold the highest standards of honesty and transparency in every engagement.' }, { title: 'Excellence', desc: 'We pursue exceptional quality and rigour in all our work.' }, { title: 'Partnership', desc: 'We build long-term collaborative relationships grounded in trust.' }, { title: 'Evidence-Based', desc: 'Every recommendation is grounded in rigorous data and research.' }, { title: 'Confidentiality', desc: 'Client information is handled with absolute discretion and security.' }, { title: 'Sustainability', desc: 'We embed long-term thinking into every strategy we craft.' }, { title: 'Agility', desc: 'We adapt quickly to evolving market conditions and client needs.' }, { title: 'Impact', desc: 'We measure our success by the tangible outcomes we create for clients.' }].

Step 6: Section 5 — Our Methodology (bg-navy text-white). section-container py-20. Centered header: label 'How We Work' (text-gold/80 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm), font-playfair text-3xl text-white mb-16 'Our Methodology'. Steps container: flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-8 md:gap-0 items-start md:items-center. Each step: flex-1 flex flex-col items-center text-center px-6 (desktop) or items-start text-left (mobile via responsive classes). Between steps (desktop only): connector div hidden md:block w-full h-0 border-t-2 border-dashed border-gold/40 mx-2 mt-[-24px] (use relative/absolute positioning or negative margin trick). Teal circle number: w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-teal flex items-center justify-center font-playfair text-white text-xl font-bold mb-4. Step title: font-semibold text-white text-lg mb-2. Step desc: text-white/70 text-sm leading-relaxed. Steps: [{ n: 1, title: 'Discovery', desc: 'Deep-dive assessment of your business context, challenges, and objectives.' }, { n: 2, title: 'Analysis', desc: 'Rigorous data analysis, benchmarking, and stakeholder interviews.' }, { n: 3, title: 'Strategy', desc: 'Tailored recommendations with clear prioritisation and a delivery roadmap.' }, { n: 4, title: 'Execution', desc: 'Hands-on implementation support and continuous performance tracking.' }]. For the dashed connector use a wrapper with relative positioning: outer div relative flex items-center justify-between, then render step circles with absolute pseudo-connector. Simplest working approach: render steps in a grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 and use an adjacent-sibling CSS workaround via inline style or just skip the connector line if it causes complexity — but do implement a visual step indicator via the teal circle number.

Step 7: Section 6 — Competitive Advantages (bg-offwhite). section-container py-20. Centered header: label 'Our Edge', font-playfair text-3xl text-navy mb-12 'Why Choose Pulse Consultant'. Grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Each card: bg-white rounded-lg p-6 border-l-4 border-gold shadow-card-1. Card title: font-semibold text-navy mb-2. Card desc: text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed. Cards: [{ title: 'Deep Industry Expertise', desc: 'Sector-specific knowledge across 5 priority industries built over 10+ years.' }, { title: 'Evidence-Based Approach', desc: 'Data-driven insights and analysis — not gut-feel recommendations.' }, { title: 'Confidentiality First', desc: 'Rigorous data protection and NDA-backed client engagements.' }, { title: 'End-to-End Solutions', desc: 'From strategic diagnosis through implementation and performance monitoring.' }, { title: 'Local Market Mastery', desc: 'Deep knowledge of African and emerging market dynamics and regulatory environments.' }, { title: 'Sustainable Growth Focus', desc: 'Strategies designed for long-term value creation, not short-term fixes.' }].

Step 8: Section 7 — CTA (bg-teal text-white). section-container py-20 text-center. font-playfair text-3xl md:text-4xl text-white mb-4: 'Partner with Pulse Consultant'. p text-white/80 text-lg mb-8: 'Let us help you turn strategic insights into sustainable growth.' Import Button from '@/components/ui/Button'. Render <Button variant='secondary' size='lg' href='/#contact'>Start a Conversation</Button>.
